newsitem.title: USA: IBM extends Aptiva line with 7 new PCs.
newsitem.headline: IBM extends Aptiva line with 7 new PCs.

text.p: IBM Corp said late Tuesday it is extending its line of Aptiva personal computers, some of which will now offer voice command operations of household appliances and remote control surfing on the World Wide Web.
The seven new personal computers will range in price from $2,149 to $2,599 and will be available at U.S. retailers in March, the company said.

The new models will allow users to operate up to 256 devices including lights and appliances with voice recognition and home automation technology. They will also allow users to browse the Internet with a remote control, the company said.
